source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mwaskom/seaborn-data/master/titanic.csv (Seaborn example-data mirror; original source is Kaggle)

model.split_strategy: StratifiedGroupKFold: identical model feature/label rows stay in one split.
model.selection_rule: Highest mean five-fold stratified group CV F1 on training partition; test set not used for selection.
